title: Receiving Missed Signal several times
symptom: After installing xDrip+ version 14fecb8-2019.01.10, the user experiences multiple 'signal missed' events between Dexcom G6, Samsung Note 8, and Galaxy wear. The event logs show 'Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120'.
evidence_quote: In the event logs, right before it drops signal, it states : "Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120"
